مُخَلَّعٌ الأَلْيَتَيْنِ A man (S) having the buttocks apart, or parted. (S, K.) ―
-b2- And مُخَلَّعٌ A weak, and soft, or flabby, man. (Lth, K.) [See also خَيْلَعٌ.] ―
-b3- (tropical:) A man (TA) in whom is what resembles a loss of reason, or a touch of insanity or of diabolical possession: (K, * TA:) and (tropical:) a man insane, or possessed by a jinnee. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
